تحتقبي (form VIII)
# تَحْتَقِبِي (taḥtaqibī) /taħ.ta.qi.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# تُحْتَقَبِي (tuḥtaqabī) /tuħ.ta.qa.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
